ar: المزمل
en: Sura 73: Al-Muzzammil

p.src: 73:1  O you the enwrapped one[1],

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
en: O you the enwrapped one[1],
u.src: 73:1  O you the enwrapped one[1],

en: [1] Allah is addressing the Messenger (ﷺ), who was wrapped in his garments.

p.src: 73:2  Stand up in prayer at night except a little,

ar: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
en: Stand up in prayer at night except a little,
u.src: 73:2  Stand up in prayer at night except a little,

p.src: 73:3  half of it, or a little less,

ar: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
en: half of it, or a little less,
u.src: 73:3  half of it, or a little less,

p.src: 73:4  or a little more, and recite the Qur’an at a measured pace.

ar: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
en: or a little more, and recite the Qur’an at a measured pace.
u.src: 73:4  or a little more, and recite the Qur’an at a measured pace.

p.src: 73:5  We will send down upon you a heavy Word[2].

ar: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا
en: We will send down upon you a heavy Word[2].
u.src: 73:5  We will send down upon you a heavy Word[2].

en: [2] i.e., the revelation, which the Prophet (ﷺ) would feel its great weight when descending upon him. Also, it is heavy for its ordinances, rulings, punishments, ethics, etc.

p.src: 73:6  Indeed, worship at night is more effective[3] and more conducive to proper recitation[4].

ar: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
en: Indeed, worship at night is more effective[3] and more conducive to proper recitation[4].
u.src: 73:6  Indeed, worship at night is more effective[3] and more conducive to proper recitation[4].

en:
[3] Or "getting up at night is more difficult...," meaning that it can only be done by sincere believers.
 [4] i.e., for reciting, hearing, and understanding of the Qur’an.

p.src: 73:7  In the daytime, you have plenty of time for your worldly matters.

ar: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا
en: In the daytime, you have plenty of time for your worldly matters.
u.src: 73:7  In the daytime, you have plenty of time for your worldly matters.

p.src: 73:8  And remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself completely to Him.

ar: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا
en: And remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself completely to Him.
u.src: 73:8  And remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself completely to Him.

p.src: 73:9  [He is] Lord of the east and the west; none has the right to be worshiped except Him, so take Him as the Disposer of your affairs[5].

ar: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا
en: [He is] Lord of the east and the west; none has the right to be worshiped except Him, so take Him as the Disposer of your affairs[5].
u.src: 73:9  [He is] Lord of the east and the west; none has the right to be worshiped except Him, so take Him as the Disposer of your affairs[5].

en: [5] i.e., trust in Allah and rely upon Him in all your matters.

p.src: 73:10  Bear patiently what they say, and avoid them in a gracious manner.

ar: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا
en: Bear patiently what they say, and avoid them in a gracious manner.
u.src: 73:10  Bear patiently what they say, and avoid them in a gracious manner.

p.src: 73:11  Leave to Me the deniers who are having a life of luxury, and bear with them for a little while.

ar: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
en: Leave to Me the deniers who are having a life of luxury, and bear with them for a little while.
u.src: 73:11  Leave to Me the deniers who are having a life of luxury, and bear with them for a little while.

p.src: 73:12  Indeed, We have heavy shackles and a Blazing Fire,

ar: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
en: Indeed, We have heavy shackles and a Blazing Fire,
u.src: 73:12  Indeed, We have heavy shackles and a Blazing Fire,

p.src: 73:13  and food that chokes, and a painful punishment,

ar: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
en: and food that chokes, and a painful punishment,
u.src: 73:13  and food that chokes, and a painful punishment,

p.src: 73:14  on the Day when the earth and the mountains will convulse, and the mountains will be like dunes of loose sand.

ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
en: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will convulse, and the mountains will be like dunes of loose sand.
u.src: 73:14  on the Day when the earth and the mountains will convulse, and the mountains will be like dunes of loose sand.

p.src: 73:15  Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger to be a witness over you, just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
en: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger to be a witness over you, just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
u.src: 73:15  Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger to be a witness over you, just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

p.src: 73:16  But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a severe punishment.

ar: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
en: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a severe punishment.
u.src: 73:16  But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a severe punishment.

p.src: 73:17  If you disbelieve, then how will you protect yourselves against a Day that will turn children’s hair gray?

ar: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
en: If you disbelieve, then how will you protect yourselves against a Day that will turn children’s hair gray?
u.src: 73:17  If you disbelieve, then how will you protect yourselves against a Day that will turn children’s hair gray?

p.src: 73:18  It will cause the sky to break asunder[6]. His promise will certainly be fulfilled.

ar: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
en: It will cause the sky to break asunder[6]. His promise will certainly be fulfilled.
u.src: 73:18  It will cause the sky to break asunder[6]. His promise will certainly be fulfilled.

en: [6] Out of the terror of that Day.

p.src: 73:19  Indeed, this is a reminder; so whoever wills may take a way to his Lord.

ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
en: Indeed, this is a reminder; so whoever wills may take a way to his Lord.
u.src: 73:19  Indeed, this is a reminder; so whoever wills may take a way to his Lord.

p.src: 73:20  Indeed, your Lord knows that you [O Prophet] stand up in prayer for nearly two-thirds of the night, or half of it, or one-third of it, as do others among your companions. Allah determines the night and the day; He knows that you [Muslims] cannot keep an accurate count of it, so He pardoned you[7]. Recite then as much of the Qur’an as is easy for you [in the night prayers]. He knows that there are some among you who will be ill, and others traveling in the land, seeking the grace of Allah, and others fighting in Allah’s way. So recite as much of it as is easy for you; establish prayer and give zakah; and lend to Allah a goodly loan[8]. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you will find it with Allah, much better in condition and much greater in reward[9]. And seek forgiveness of Allah, for indeed Allah is All-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.

ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ
en: Indeed, your Lord knows that you [O Prophet] stand up in prayer for nearly two-thirds of the night, or half of it, or one-third of it, as do others among your companions. Allah determines the night and the day; He knows that you [Muslims] cannot keep an accurate count of it, so He pardoned you[7]. Recite then as much of the Qur’an as is easy for you [in the night prayers]. He knows that there are some among you who will be ill, and others traveling in the land, seeking the grace of Allah, and others fighting in Allah’s way. So recite as much of it as is easy for you; establish prayer and give zakah; and lend to Allah a goodly loan[8]. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you will find it with Allah, much better in condition and much greater in reward[9]. And seek forgiveness of Allah, for indeed Allah is All-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.
u.src: 73:20  Indeed, your Lord knows that you [O Prophet] stand up in prayer for nearly two-thirds of the night, or half of it, or one-third of it, as do others among your companions. Allah determines the night and the day; He knows that you [Muslims] cannot keep an accurate count of it, so He pardoned you[7]. Recite then as much of the Qur’an as is easy for you [in the night prayers]. He knows that there are some among you who will be ill, and others traveling in the land, seeking the grace of Allah, and others fighting in Allah’s way. So recite as much of it as is easy for you; establish prayer and give zakah; and lend to Allah a goodly loan[8]. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you will find it with Allah, much better in condition and much greater in reward[9]. And seek forgiveness of Allah, for indeed Allah is All-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.

en:
[7] The ruling mentioned at the beginning of this surah is lightened here. So from now on, the believers do not have to stick to any of the portions specified there; rather, they can pray whatever they can at night. It is out of the mercy of Allah upon His servants that He does not want hardship for them.
 [8] i.e., giving in charity and for His causes.
 [9] It will be rewarded tenfold, or 700-fold, and Allah gives even more to whoever He wills. See 2:261.
